database.integration_optimized

Optimized database integration with performance configuration.

This module provides enhanced database integration using the performance optimization features developed in Phases 1-5.

Classes

OptimizedTwinDatabaseIntegration

Enhanced database integration with performance optimizations.

Module Contents

class database.integration_optimized.OptimizedTwinDatabaseIntegration(db_manager=None, perf_config=None)[source]

Enhanced database integration with performance optimizations.

This class integrates all performance optimizations from Phases 1-5: - Configurable performance settings - Memory-efficient event handling - Batched database operations - Progress reporting - State persistence - Automatic mode switching on memory pressure

Parameters:

  • db_manager (Optional[database.manager.TwinDatabaseManager])

  • perf_config (Optional[twin_model.config.PerformanceConfig])

run_simulation_to_db(run_type='experiment', parameters=None, days=1, parent_run_id=None, perf_config=None, show_progress=True)[source]

Run optimized simulation and store results in database.

Uses all performance optimizations including: - Circular buffers for memory efficiency - Event sampling based on configuration - Batched database operations - Cache-based event storage - Progress reporting - Automatic checkpointing

Parameters:

  • run_type (str) – Type of simulation run

  • parameters (Dict[str, Any]) – Simulation parameters

  • days (float) – Duration in days

  • parent_run_id (Optional[str]) – Optional parent run ID

  • perf_config (Optional[twin_model.config.PerformanceConfig]) – Override performance configuration

  • show_progress (bool) – Show progress updates

Returns:

Run ID of completed simulation

Raises:

Exception – If simulation fails

Return type:

str
